title: Chime Financial Set to Join S&P MidCap 400

body_markdown:
NEW YORK


, Nov. 13, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Chime Financial Inc. (NASD: CHYM) will replace NorthWestern Energy Group Inc. (NASD: NWE) in the S&P MidCap 400 effective prior to the opening of trading on Wednesday, November 18. S&P MidCap 400 constituent Black Hills Corp. (NYSE: BKH) is acquiring NorthWestern Energy Group in a deal expected to be completed today. Post-merger, the combined company will remain in the S&P MidCap 400 and will be renamed Bright Horizon Energy Corp. (NYSE: HZN).
